records.literal_gloss: And it was, in [the] coming out of the priests from the holy [place], for all the priests who were present had consecrated themselves, [there was] not keeping to divisions,

en.L: And it happened, when the priests came out from the holy [place], for all the priests who were present had consecrated themselves, without keeping to [their] divisions,
en.B: Then the priests came out of the holy place. All the priests who were present had consecrated themselves, whatever their division.
en.R: Then the priests came out of the holy place. All the priests who were there had made themselves holy for this day, not only those whose group was on duty.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando los sacerdotes salieron del [lugar] santo, porque todos los sacerdotes que se hallaban [allí] se habían santificado, sin guardar [sus] turnos,
es.B: Entonces los sacerdotes salieron del lugar santo. Todos los sacerdotes que estaban presentes se habían santificado, fuera cual fuera su turno.
es.R: Entonces los sacerdotes salieron del lugar santo. Todos los sacerdotes que estaban allí se habían purificado para ese día, no solo los del grupo al que le tocaba servir.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand les prêtres sortirent du lieu saint, car tous les prêtres qui se trouvaient là s’étaient sanctifiés sans observer [leurs] classes,
fr.B: Alors les prêtres sortirent du lieu saint. Tous les prêtres présents s’étaient sanctifiés, quelle que soit leur classe.
fr.R: Alors les prêtres sont sortis du lieu saint. Tous les prêtres qui étaient là s’étaient purifiés pour ce jour, et pas seulement ceux dont le groupe était de service.

sw.L: Ikawa makuhani walipotoka patakatifu, kwa maana makuhani wote waliokuwapo walikuwa wamejitakasa, bila kufuata zamu [zao],
sw.B: Kisha makuhani wakatoka patakatifu. Makuhani wote waliokuwapo walikuwa wamejitakasa, bila kujali zamu zao.
sw.R: Kisha makuhani wakatoka patakatifu. Makuhani wote waliokuwapo walikuwa wamejitakasa kwa ajili ya siku hiyo, si wale tu ambao zamu yao ilikuwa imefika.

vi.L: Và xảy ra, khi các thầy tế lễ ra khỏi nơi thánh, vì tất cả các thầy tế lễ có mặt đã thánh hóa mình, không giữ theo các ban [của mình],
vi.B: Rồi các thầy tế lễ ra khỏi nơi thánh. Tất cả các thầy tế lễ có mặt đều đã thánh hóa mình, bất kể thuộc ban nào.
vi.R: Rồi các thầy tế lễ ra khỏi nơi thánh. Tất cả các thầy tế lễ có mặt ở đó đều đã dọn mình nên thánh cho ngày này, chứ không phải chỉ những người thuộc ban đang phiên trực.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장들이 성소에서 나올 때에 일어난 일이다. 거기 있던 제사장들은 모두 자기 반열을 지키지 않고 스스로 거룩하게 했으며,
ko.B: 그때 제사장들이 성소에서 나왔다. 거기 있던 제사장들은 반열에 상관없이 모두 자신을 거룩하게 구별했다.
ko.R: 그때 제사장들이 성소에서 나왔다. 그곳에 있던 제사장들은 그날 당번인 무리만이 아니라 모두 이날을 위해 자신을 깨끗하게 했다.

pt.L: E aconteceu que, quando os sacerdotes saíram do [Lugar] Santo, porque todos os sacerdotes que se achavam [ali] tinham se consagrado, sem respeitar as [suas] turmas,
pt.B: Então os sacerdotes saíram do Lugar Santo. Todos os sacerdotes que estavam presentes tinham se consagrado, fosse qual fosse a sua turma.
pt.R: Então os sacerdotes saíram do Lugar Santo. Todos os sacerdotes que estavam ali tinham se santificado para aquele dia, e não só os da turma que estava de serviço.

am.L: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ካህናቱ ከቅዱሱ [ስፍራ] በወጡ ጊዜ፣ በዚያ የተገኙት ካህናት ሁሉ ክፍሎቻቸውን ሳይጠብቁ ራሳቸውን ቀድሰው ነበርና፣
am.B: ከዚያም ካህናቱ ከቅዱሱ ስፍራ ወጡ። በዚያ የተገኙት ካህናት ሁሉ ከየትኛውም ክፍል ቢሆኑ ራሳቸውን ቀድሰው ነበር።
am.R: ከዚያም ካህናቱ ከቅዱሱ ስፍራ ወጡ። በዚያ የነበሩት ካህናት ሁሉ የአገልግሎት ተራቸው የደረሰው ብቻ ሳይሆኑ ለዚህ ቀን ራሳቸውን ቀድሰው ነበር።

hi.L: और ऐसा हुआ, जब याजक पवित्र [स्थान] से निकले, क्योंकि जितने याजक उपस्थित थे सब ने अपने आप को पवित्र किया था, [अपने] दलों का ध्यान किए बिना,
hi.B: तब याजक पवित्र स्थान से बाहर आए। जितने याजक वहाँ उपस्थित थे, उन सब ने अपने आप को पवित्र किया था, चाहे वे किसी भी दल के हों।
hi.R: तब याजक पवित्र स्थान से बाहर आए। जितने याजक वहाँ थे, उन सब ने इस दिन के लिए अपने आप को पवित्र किया था, केवल वे ही नहीं जिनके दल की उस समय सेवा की बारी थी।

ru.L: И было, когда вышли священники из святилища, — ведь все священники, которые находились [там], освятились, не соблюдая [своих] черёд, —
ru.B: Затем священники вышли из святилища. Все священники, которые были там, освятились, к какой бы череде они ни принадлежали.
ru.R: Потом священники вышли из святилища. Все священники, которые были там, очистились и посвятили себя Богу для этого дня, а не только те, чья очередь была служить.

ja.L: そして、祭司たちが聖所から出て来たとき――そこにいた祭司たちはみな、組[の順番]を守ることなく、自分を聖別していた――、
ja.B: そして祭司たちが聖所から出て来た。そこにいた祭司たちはみな、組の区別なく身を聖別していた。
ja.R: それから、祭司たちは聖所から出て来ました。そこにいた祭司たちはみな、この日のために身を清めて聖なる者となっていました。当番の組の祭司たちだけではありませんでした。

uk.L: І сталося, коли священники вийшли зі святого [місця], бо всі священники, що були присутні, освятилися, не дотримуючись [своїх] черг,
uk.B: Тоді священники вийшли зі святого місця. Усі священники, які були там, освятилися, хоч би до якої черги вони належали.
uk.R: Тоді священники вийшли зі святого місця. Усі священники, які були там, освятилися на цей день, а не тільки ті, чия група була на служінні.

decisions.choice: verses 11-13 add to 1 Kings 8:10
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 8:10 says simply that when the priests came out of the holy place, the cloud filled the house. Chronicles opens the same way, then tells of the priests, the singers and the music (verses 11-13) before the cloud comes.

decisions.choice: one long sentence: "when the priests came out ..." finds its main clause at the end of verse 13
decisions.reason: The Hebrew begins "And it happened, when the priests came out", then stops to describe the priests (verse 11) and the singers and trumpeters (verse 12), and only in verse 13 says what happened: the house was filled with a cloud.

decisions.choice: consecrated themselves without keeping to their divisions: every priest present took part, not only the group on duty
decisions.reason: David divided the priests into twenty-four groups that served in turn (1 Chronicles 24:1-19). For this day every priest who was there had made himself ready, so the rota was set aside. Compare 30:3, where not enough priests had consecrated themselves.

decisions.choice: the holy place: the sanctuary where they had set the ark
decisions.reason: The priests had gone into the inner sanctuary to set the ark in place (verse 7), as in 1 Kings 8:10.

decisions.choice: full sentences (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the long sentence of verses 11-13 and ends this verse with a comma. Balanced and Readable break it into shorter sentences, and say in verse 13 that the cloud came while the music was sounding.

decisions.choice: whatever their division (Balanced); not only those whose group was on duty (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say plainly what "without keeping to divisions" means (m3). Readable says "made themselves holy" for "consecrated themselves", as in 1 Chronicles 15:12.

decisions.choice: one long sentence (L); full sentences (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1): Literal keeps the Hebrew sentence that runs to the end of verse 13; Balanced and Readable break it up.

decisions.choice: "classes"
decisions.reason: The priests' divisions, which took turns at the temple (1 Chronicles 24), are "classes", the usual French word for the priestly courses; Readable says "groupe ... de service", as the English Readable explains it.

decisions.choice: full sentences (B, R); one long sentence ending with a comma (L)
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal keeps the long sentence of verses 11-13 (m2); Balanced and Readable break it into shorter ones.

decisions.choice: "반열" (L, B) for the priests' divisions; "당번인 무리" (R)
decisions.reason: The usual Korean word for the priestly divisions; Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: as turmas
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the priestly and levitical divisions David set up (m3) are "as turmas", the word 1 Chronicles 24 uses for them in Portuguese, a group that serves in its turn. "O [Lugar] Santo" (L) and "o Lugar Santo" (B, R) as 1 Kings 8:8-10 in Portuguese (m4).

decisions.choice: "ክፍሎች" for the priests' divisions; Literal keeps the sentence open ("… በወጡ ጊዜ፣ … ቀድሰው ነበርና፣") to its main clause in verse 13
decisions.reason: Chronicles breaks into 1 Kings 8:10 with verses 11b-13a about the priests and singers, and resumes "the house was filled with a cloud" at the end of verse 13; Literal keeps that long sentence, Balanced and Readable split it as the English does.

decisions.choice: "череды" (L, B); "чья очередь была служить" (R)
decisions.reason: The priests' divisions served in turn; "череда" is the Russian word for such a turn of service (as in Luke 1:5). Readable says what keeping to them meant (m3).

decisions.choice: verse closes with a dash, the sentence going on to verse 13
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the long sentence of verses 11-13; the dashes set off the aside about the priests, where the English uses commas.

decisions.choice: L keeps the one long sentence of 5:11-13 ("…とき――…――、" … "…とき、"), with the main clause at the end of verse 13; B and R make full sentences as the English.
decisions.reason: The meaning decision marks the long sentence; the dashes hold the because-clause inside it.

decisions.choice: hitqaddeshu "身を清めて聖なる者となって" (R), "聖別" (L, B).
decisions.reason: As 1 Chronicles 15:12, 15:14 R.

source.text: וְהַלְוִיִּ֣ם הַמְשֹׁרֲרִ֣ים לְכֻלָּ֡ם לְאָסָ֡ף לְהֵימָ֣ן לִֽ֠ידֻתוּן וְלִבְנֵיהֶ֨ם וְלַאֲחֵיהֶ֜ם מְלֻבָּשִׁ֣ים בּ֗וּץ בִּמְצִלְתַּ֨יִם֙ וּבִנְבָלִ֣ים וְכִנֹּר֔וֹת עֹמְדִ֖ים מִזְרָ֣ח לַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְעִמָּהֶ֤ם כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ לְמֵאָ֣ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֔ים מַחְצְרִ֖ים בַּחֲצֹֽצְרֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: and the Levites the singers, all of them, Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and their brothers, clothed [in] fine linen, with cymbals and with harps and lyres, standing east of the altar, and with them priests, one hundred and twenty, blowing on trumpets,

en.L: and the Levites, the singers, all of them, Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and their brothers, clothed [in] fine linen, with cymbals and with harps and lyres, [were] standing east of the altar, and with them [were] 120 priests blowing on trumpets,
en.B: All the Levites who were singers, Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun with their sons and relatives, were standing east of the altar, dressed in fine linen, with cymbals, harps and lyres. With them were 120 priests blowing trumpets.
en.R: All the Levite singers were standing on the east side of the altar. They were Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun and their sons and relatives. They were dressed in fine linen and held cymbals, harps and lyres. With them were 120 priests who played trumpets.

es.L: y los levitas cantores, todos ellos, Asaf, Hemán, Jedutún, y sus hijos y sus hermanos, vestidos [de] lino fino, con címbalos y con arpas y liras, [estaban] de pie al oriente del altar, y con ellos [había] 120 sacerdotes que tocaban trompetas,
es.B: Todos los levitas cantores, Asaf, Hemán y Jedutún con sus hijos y parientes, estaban de pie al oriente del altar, vestidos de lino fino, con címbalos, arpas y liras. Con ellos había 120 sacerdotes que tocaban trompetas.
es.R: Todos los levitas cantores estaban de pie al lado este del altar. Eran Asaf, Hemán y Jedutún y sus hijos y parientes. Estaban vestidos de lino fino y tenían címbalos, arpas y liras. Con ellos había 120 sacerdotes que tocaban trompetas.

fr.L: et les Lévites, les chanteurs, eux tous, Asaph, Hémân, Jeduthun, et leurs fils et leurs frères, vêtus de fin lin, avec des cymbales, et avec des harpes et des lyres, [se tenaient] à l’est de l’autel, et avec eux [étaient] cent vingt prêtres qui sonnaient des trompettes,
fr.B: Tous les Lévites qui étaient chanteurs, Asaph, Hémân et Jeduthun avec leurs fils et leurs frères, se tenaient à l’est de l’autel, vêtus de fin lin, avec des cymbales, des harpes et des lyres. Avec eux, il y avait cent vingt prêtres qui sonnaient des trompettes.
fr.R: Tous les chanteurs lévites se tenaient du côté est de l’autel. C’étaient Asaph, Hémân et Jeduthun, avec leurs fils et leurs frères. Ils étaient vêtus de fin lin et tenaient des cymbales, des harpes et des lyres. Avec eux, il y avait cent vingt prêtres qui jouaient de la trompette.

sw.L: na Walawi waimbaji, wote, Asafu, Hemani, Yeduthuni, na wana wao na ndugu zao, wamevaa kitani safi, wakiwa na matoazi na vinubi na zeze, [walikuwa] wamesimama upande wa mashariki wa madhabahu, na pamoja nao makuhani 120 wakipiga tarumbeta,
sw.B: Walawi wote waliokuwa waimbaji, Asafu, Hemani na Yeduthuni pamoja na wana wao na jamaa zao, walikuwa wamesimama upande wa mashariki wa madhabahu, wamevaa kitani safi, wakiwa na matoazi, vinubi na zeze. Pamoja nao walikuwa makuhani 120 wakipiga tarumbeta.
sw.R: Walawi wote waimbaji walikuwa wamesimama upande wa mashariki wa madhabahu. Hao walikuwa Asafu, Hemani na Yeduthuni pamoja na wana wao na jamaa zao. Walikuwa wamevaa kitani safi na kushika matoazi, vinubi na zeze. Pamoja nao walikuwa makuhani 120 waliopiga tarumbeta.

vi.L: và những người Lê-vi là ca sĩ, tất cả bọn họ, A-sáp, Hê-man, Giê-đu-thun, cùng các con trai và anh em họ, mặc vải gai mịn, với chập chỏa, đàn hạc và đàn lia, [đều] đứng ở phía đông bàn thờ, và cùng với họ [có] 120 thầy tế lễ thổi kèn,
vi.B: Tất cả những người Lê-vi là ca sĩ, A-sáp, Hê-man và Giê-đu-thun cùng các con trai và họ hàng của họ, đứng ở phía đông bàn thờ, mặc vải gai mịn, cầm chập chỏa, đàn hạc và đàn lia. Cùng với họ có 120 thầy tế lễ thổi kèn.
vi.R: Tất cả các ca sĩ người Lê-vi đứng ở phía đông bàn thờ. Đó là A-sáp, Hê-man và Giê-đu-thun cùng các con trai và họ hàng của họ. Họ mặc vải gai mịn và cầm chập chỏa, đàn hạc và đàn lia. Cùng với họ có 120 thầy tế lễ thổi kèn.

ko.L: 그리고 노래하는 레위인들, 곧 아삽과 헤만과 여두둔과 그들의 아들들과 형제들이 모두 고운 베옷을 입고 심벌즈와 비파와 수금을 들고 제단 동쪽에 서 있었고, 그들과 함께 제사장 120명이 나팔을 불고 있었다.
ko.B: 노래하는 레위인들, 곧 아삽과 헤만과 여두둔과 그들의 아들들과 친척들이 모두 고운 베옷을 입고 심벌즈와 비파와 수금을 들고 제단 동쪽에 서 있었다. 그들과 함께 제사장 120명이 나팔을 불고 있었다.
ko.R: 노래하는 레위인들은 모두 제단 동쪽에 서 있었다. 그들은 아삽과 헤만과 여두둔과 그들의 아들들과 친척들이었다. 그들은 고운 베옷을 입고 심벌즈와 비파와 수금을 들고 있었다. 그들과 함께 제사장 120명이 나팔을 불었다.

pt.L: e os levitas, os cantores, todos eles, Asafe, Hemã, Jedutum, e os seus filhos, e os seus irmãos, vestidos [de] linho fino, com címbalos, e com harpas e liras, [estavam] de pé a leste do altar, e com eles [estavam] cento e vinte sacerdotes tocando trombetas,
pt.B: Todos os levitas que eram cantores, Asafe, Hemã e Jedutum, com os seus filhos e parentes, estavam de pé a leste do altar, vestidos de linho fino, com címbalos, harpas e liras. Com eles estavam cento e vinte sacerdotes tocando trombetas.
pt.R: Todos os levitas cantores estavam de pé no lado leste do altar. Eram Asafe, Hemã e Jedutum, com os seus filhos e parentes. Estavam vestidos de linho fino e seguravam címbalos, harpas e liras. Com eles estavam cento e vinte sacerdotes que tocavam trombetas.

ru.L: и левиты-певцы, все они — Асаф, Еман, Идифун, и сыновья их, и братья их, одетые в виссон, с кимвалами, и с арфами, и с лирами, — стоящие к востоку от жертвенника, и с ними сто двадцать священников, трубящих в трубы, —
ru.B: Все левиты-певцы — Асаф, Еман и Идифун со своими сыновьями и родственниками — стояли к востоку от жертвенника, одетые в виссон, с кимвалами, арфами и лирами. С ними были 120 священников, трубивших в трубы.
ru.R: Все певцы из левитов стояли с восточной стороны жертвенника. Это были Асаф, Еман и Идифун, их сыновья и родственники. Они были одеты в одежды из тонкого льна и держали в руках кимвалы, арфы и лиры. С ними были 120 священников, которые трубили в трубы.

ja.L: また歌い手であるレビ人たちがみな、すなわちアサフ、ヘマン、エドトンと、彼らの子らと兄弟たちが、上等の亜麻布をまとい、シンバルと琴と竪琴を持って祭壇の東に立ち、彼らと共に百二十人の祭司たちがラッパを吹き鳴らしていたとき、
ja.B: 歌い手であるレビ人たちはみな、すなわちアサフ、ヘマン、エドトンとその子らや親族は、上等の亜麻布をまとい、シンバルと琴と竪琴を持って祭壇の東側に立っていた。彼らと共に、百二十人の祭司がラッパを吹き鳴らしていた。
ja.R: 歌い手であるレビ人たちはみな、祭壇の東側に立っていました。アサフ、ヘマン、エドトンと、その息子たちや親族です。彼らは上等の亜麻布の服を着て、シンバルや琴やたて琴を持っていました。彼らと一緒に、ラッパを吹く百二十人の祭司たちがいました。

uk.L: і левити, співці, усі вони, Асаф, Геман, Єдутун, і їхні сини, і їхні брати, зодягнені [в] тонкий льон, з цимбалами, і з арфами, і з лірами, стояли на схід від жертовника, а з ними сто двадцять священників, що сурмили в сурми,
uk.B: Усі левити-співці, Асаф, Геман і Єдутун з їхніми синами й родичами, стояли на схід від жертовника, зодягнені в тонкий льон, з цимбалами, арфами й лірами. З ними було сто двадцять священників, що сурмили в сурми.
uk.R: Усі левити-співці стояли на східному боці жертовника. Це були Асаф, Геман і Єдутун та їхні сини й родичі. Вони були зодягнені в тонкий льон і тримали цимбали, арфи й ліри. З ними було сто двадцять священників, які сурмили в сурми.

decisions.choice: all of them, Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun: the list names who the singers were
decisions.reason: Each name in the list begins with a small word meaning "to" or "belonging to", used here to set out the members of a group, as in 1 Chronicles 25:1-6. It says who the singers were: the three leaders and their families.

decisions.choice: Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun: the leaders of the temple singers David appointed
decisions.reason: David set these three and their sons over the music of worship (1 Chronicles 16:41-42; 25:1-6). Jeduthun is probably the Ethan of 1 Chronicles 15:19.

decisions.choice: clothed in fine linen: dressed for service in worship
decisions.reason: Fine linen was worn by those who served at the sanctuary. The Levites and singers wore it when David brought the ark to Jerusalem (1 Chronicles 15:27).

decisions.choice: cymbals, harps and lyres: the instruments of the Levite singers
decisions.reason: The cymbals were a pair of bronze plates struck together; harps and lyres were the two stringed instruments, the harp the larger, as in 1 Chronicles 15:16 and 25:1.

decisions.choice: 120 priests blowing trumpets: the priests' task in worship
decisions.reason: The law gave the trumpets to the priests, to be blown at festivals and offerings (Numbers 10:8-10; 1 Chronicles 15:24; 16:6).

decisions.choice: relatives (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: "Brothers" here means fellow members of the singers' families, as in 1 Chronicles 15:16.

decisions.choice: "Asaf, Hemán, Jedutún"
decisions.reason: The three singers take the forms of the published Spanish Psalm titles (Asaf, Jedutún) and of 1 Kings 5:11 (Hemán).

decisions.choice: "Asaph, Hémân, Jeduthun"; "leurs frères"
decisions.reason: The names as the French Psalms titles have them (Psalms 39, 50, 88). French keeps "frères" at every level: in a list of singers' families it reads naturally as their kinsmen, where the English says "relatives".

decisions.choice: Asafu, Hemani, Yeduthuni
decisions.reason: The forms of the Swahili Psalm titles.

decisions.choice: "chập chỏa, đàn hạc và đàn lia"; "ca sĩ"
decisions.reason: The names of the Levites' instruments (m4) and the singers kept through Chronicles; the names A-sáp, Hê-man and Giê-đu-thun as the published Psalm titles.

decisions.choice: "심벌즈", "비파", "수금"
decisions.reason: Korean names for the Levites' instruments, used for the same Hebrew words in the Psalms drafts.

decisions.choice: Asafe, Hemã, Jedutum; címbalos, harpas e liras; trombetas; linho fino
decisions.reason: The singers, their leaders and their instruments keep the wording 1 Chronicles 15:16-27 and 16:41 set in Portuguese for the books of Chronicles (m2-m5): "os cantores", "Asafe", "Hemã", "Jedutum", "címbalos", "harpas" for the larger stringed instrument and "liras" for the smaller, "trombetas" for the priests' metal trumpets, and "linho fino".

decisions.choice: cymbals "ቃጭል", harps "መሰንቆ", lyres "በገና", trumpets "መለከት"; Asaph "አሳፍ", Heman "ሄማን", Jeduthun "ይዱቱን"
decisions.reason: As 2 Chronicles 29 and Ezra 3:10 in Amharic; the names keep the forms used elsewhere in Chronicles and in 1 Kings 5:11.

decisions.choice: "झाँझ", "सारंगी" (nevel), "वीणा" (kinnor); "तुरही"
decisions.reason: The instruments keep the words of 1 Kings 10:12 (वीणाएँ और सारंगियाँ), with the harp (nevel) as सारंगी and the lyre (kinnor) as वीणा; cymbals are झाँझ and trumpets तुरही.
"Brothers" here means members of the singers' families, and Balanced and Readable say संबंधी, as the English says "relatives"; Literal keeps भाई.

decisions.choice: "Асаф, Еман, Идифун"; "кимвалы, арфы и лиры"
decisions.reason: The traditional Russian forms of the singers' names, and the instruments as in 1 Kings 10:12, in the Hebrew order here.

decisions.choice: metsiltayim "シンバル", nevalim "琴", kinnorot "竪琴" (L, B), "たて琴" (R); meshorerim "歌い手"; chatsotserot "ラッパ", as 1 Chronicles 15-16.
decisions.reason: The Levites' music terms are kept as in 1 Chronicles.

source.text: וַיְהִ֣י כְ֠אֶחָד לַמְחַצְּרִ֨ים וְלַמְשֹֽׁרֲרִ֜ים לְהַשְׁמִ֣יעַ קוֹל־אֶחָ֗ד לְהַלֵּ֣ל וּלְהֹדוֹת֮ לַיהוָה֒ וּכְהָרִ֣ים ק֠וֹל בַּחֲצֹצְר֨וֹת וּבִמְצִלְתַּ֜יִם וּבִכְלֵ֣י הַשִּׁ֗יר וּבְהַלֵּ֤ל לַיהוָה֙ כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב כִּ֥י לְעוֹלָ֖ם חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְהַבַּ֛יִת מָלֵ֥א עָנָ֖ן בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: and it was, as one, for the trumpeters and for the singers to make heard one voice, to praise and to give thanks to Yahweh, and as raising [the] voice with trumpets and with cymbals and with instruments of the song, and in praising Yahweh, for [he is] good, for to forever [is] his loyal love, and the house was filled [with a] cloud, [the] house of Yahweh,

en.L: and it happened, as one, for the trumpeters and for the singers to make one sound heard, to praise and to give thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; and as [they] raised [the] sound with trumpets and with cymbals and with instruments of song, and praised {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "For [{{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is] good, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever," that the house was filled [with] a cloud, the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}},
en.B: The trumpeters and the singers joined as one, making a single sound heard as they praised and thanked {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. As they raised the sound with trumpets, cymbals and other musical instruments and praised {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is good; {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever," the house, the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, was filled with a cloud,
en.R: The trumpet players and the singers joined together to praise and thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as if with one voice. They played their trumpets, cymbals and other instruments and praised {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, singing, "He is good! His faithful love lasts forever." Then the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was filled with a cloud.

es.L: y sucedió que, como uno solo, los trompeteros y los cantores hicieron oír una sola voz para alabar y dar gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}; y cuando alzaban la voz con trompetas y con címbalos y con instrumentos de música, y alababan {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «Porque [{{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es] bueno, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal [es] para siempre», entonces la casa se llenó de una nube, la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}},
es.B: Los trompeteros y los cantores se unieron como uno solo, haciendo oír una sola voz para alabar y dar gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Cuando alzaron la voz con trompetas, címbalos y otros instrumentos de música, y alabaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} diciendo: «Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es bueno; {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre», la casa, la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, se llenó de una nube,
es.R: Los que tocaban las trompetas y los cantores se unieron para alabar y dar gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} como si fueran una sola voz. Tocaron sus trompetas, címbalos y otros instrumentos y alabaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} cantando: «¡Él es bueno! ¡Su amor fiel dura para siempre!». Entonces el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se llenó de una nube.

fr.L: et il arriva, comme un seul [homme], que les trompettes et les chanteurs firent entendre une seule voix pour louer et célébrer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; et quand [ils] élevèrent la voix avec les trompettes, et avec les cymbales, et avec les instruments de chant, et louèrent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : « Car [{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est] bon, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours », alors la maison fut remplie d’une nuée, la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}},
fr.B: Les trompettes et les chanteurs s’unirent comme un seul homme pour faire entendre une seule voix en louant et en célébrant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Et tandis qu’ils élevaient la voix avec les trompettes, les cymbales et les autres instruments de musique, et qu’ils louaient {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : « Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est bon, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours », la maison, la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, fut remplie d’une nuée,
fr.R: Les joueurs de trompette et les chanteurs se sont unis pour louer et remercier {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, comme d’une seule voix. Ils ont joué de la trompette, des cymbales et des autres instruments, et ils ont loué {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} en chantant : « Il est bon ! Son amour fidèle dure toujours. » Alors le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} s’est rempli d’une nuée.

sw.L: ikawa, kama mmoja, wapiga tarumbeta na waimbaji walitoa sauti moja ikasikika, ya kumsifu na kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; na walipopaza sauti kwa tarumbeta na kwa matoazi na kwa vyombo vya wimbo, na kumsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "Kwa maana [{{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni] mwema, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele," ndipo nyumba ikajazwa wingu, nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}},
sw.B: Wapiga tarumbeta na waimbaji waliungana kama mtu mmoja, wakitoa sauti moja ikasikika walipomsifu na kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Walipopaza sauti kwa tarumbeta, matoazi na vyombo vingine vya muziki, wakimsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni mwema; upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele," nyumba, yaani nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ikajaa wingu,
sw.R: Wapiga tarumbeta na waimbaji waliungana kumsifu na kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kana kwamba kwa sauti moja. Walipiga tarumbeta, matoazi na vyombo vingine, wakamsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wakiimba, "Yeye ni mwema! Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele." Ndipo hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} likajaa wingu.

vi.L: và xảy ra, như một, những người thổi kèn và những người ca hát cùng cất lên một tiếng để ca ngợi và cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; và khi [họ] cất tiếng với kèn, với chập chỏa và với các nhạc cụ, và ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Vì [Ngài là] tốt lành, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời," thì nhà đầy dẫy một đám mây, tức nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}},
vi.B: Những người thổi kèn và những người ca hát cùng hòa làm một, cất lên một tiếng để ca ngợi và cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Khi họ cất tiếng với kèn, chập chỏa và các nhạc cụ khác mà ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là tốt lành; tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời," thì nhà, tức là nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đầy dẫy một đám mây,
vi.R: Những người thổi kèn và những người ca hát cùng hòa nhau ca ngợi và cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} như thể bằng một tiếng. Họ thổi kèn, đánh chập chỏa và chơi các nhạc cụ khác, rồi ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} rằng: "Ngài thật tốt lành! Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời." Bấy giờ đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đầy dẫy một đám mây.

ko.L: 나팔 부는 사람들과 노래하는 사람들이 하나가 되어 한 소리를 내어 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하고 감사했다. 그리고 그들이 나팔과 심벌즈와 노래하는 악기들로 소리를 높여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하기를 "[그분은] 선하시고, 참으로 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다" 할 때, 그 집, 곧 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 구름이 가득 찼다.
ko.B: 나팔 부는 사람들과 노래하는 사람들이 하나가 되어 한 소리로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하고 감사했다. 그들이 나팔과 심벌즈와 여러 악기로 소리를 높여 "그분은 선하시다. 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다" 하고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양할 때, 그 집, 곧 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 구름이 가득 찼다.
ko.R: 나팔 부는 사람들과 노래하는 사람들은 마치 한 목소리처럼 함께 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하고 감사했다. 그들은 나팔과 심벌즈와 여러 악기를 연주하며 "그분은 좋으신 분이시다! 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다" 하고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양했다. 그때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 구름이 가득 찼다.

am.L: መለከት ነፊዎቹና መዘምራኑም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ለማወደስና ለማመስገን እንደ አንድ ሰው ሆነው አንድ ድምፅ አሰሙ፤ በመለከትና በቃጭል በዜማ ዕቃዎችም ድምፃቸውን ከፍ አድርገው «መልካም ነውና፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ነውና» እያሉ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ሲያወድሱ ቤቱ፣ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቤት፣ በደመና ተሞላ፤
am.B: መለከት ነፊዎቹና መዘምራኑ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እያወደሱና እያመሰገኑ እንደ አንድ ሰው በአንድ ድምፅ ተባበሩ። በመለከት፣ በቃጭልና በሌሎችም የዜማ ዕቃዎች ድምፃቸውን ከፍ አድርገው «እርሱ መልካም ነው፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል» እያሉ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ሲያወድሱ ቤቱ፣ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ፣ በደመና ተሞላ፤
am.R: መለከት ነፊዎቹና መዘምራኑ በአንድ ድምፅ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ለማወደስና ለማመስገን ተባበሩ። መለከታቸውን፣ ቃጭላቸውንና ሌሎቹን የዜማ ዕቃዎች እየተጫወቱ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አወደሱ፤ እንዲህም ብለው ዘመሩ፦ «እርሱ መልካም ነው፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።» ያን ጊዜ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቤተ መቅደስ በደመና ተሞላ።

hi.B: तुरही फूँकनेवाले और गायक एक होकर एक ही स्वर में {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति और धन्यवाद करने लगे। जब उन्होंने तुरहियों, झाँझों और दूसरे बाजों के साथ स्वर ऊँचा करके {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की स्तुति की, "क्योंकि वे भले हैं; उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है," तब भवन, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भवन, बादल से भर गया,

ru.L: и было — как один, трубачам и певцам дать слышать один голос, чтобы хвалить и благодарить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}; и когда подняли [они] голос с трубами, и с кимвалами, и с музыкальными орудиями, и хвалили {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}: «Потому что [{{deity_pronoun:он|Он}}] благ, потому что вовек неизменная любовь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}», — тогда дом наполнило облако, дом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}},

И когда они подняли голос под звуки труб, кимвалов и других музыкальных инструментов и хвалили {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}: «Ведь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} добр; {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменная любовь длится вечно», — дом, дом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, наполнился облаком,

Они играли на трубах, кимвалах и других инструментах и хвалили {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, воспевая: «Потому что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} добр! Его неизменная любовь длится вечно.» Тогда храм {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} наполнился облаком.

uk.L: і сталося, як одне, сурмачам і співцям — дати почути один звук, щоб хвалити й дякувати {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}; і коли [вони] піднесли звук сурмами, і цимбалами, і знаряддями пісні, і хвалили {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}: «Бо [{{deity_pronoun:він|Він}}] добрий, бо навіки {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов», — то дім наповнився хмарою, дім {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНІЙ|Ягве}},
uk.B: Сурмачі й співці зʼєдналися як один, щоб було чути один звук, коли вони хвалили й дякували {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}. І коли вони піднесли звук сурмами, цимбалами й іншими музичними знаряддями і хвалили {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}: «Бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} добрий; незмінна любов {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} триває вічно», — дім, дім {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНІЙ|Ягве}}, наповнився хмарою,
uk.R: Сурмачі й співці разом хвалили й дякували {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, ніби одним голосом. Вони грали на сурмах, цимбалах та інших знаряддях і хвалили {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, співаючи: «Він добрий! Його вірна любов триває вічно.» Тоді храм {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНІЙ|Ягве}} наповнився хмарою.

decisions.choice: as one ... one sound: in perfect unity
decisions.reason: The verse says twice that the music was one: the trumpeters and singers were "as one", and they made "one sound" heard. The praise of the whole company rose together.

decisions.choice: for he is good, for his loyal love is forever: the refrain of Israel's praise
decisions.reason: These are the words of Psalm 136:1 and 106:1, 107:1 and 118:1, sung when the ark came to Jerusalem (1 Chronicles 16:34), sung again when fire fell on the altar (7:3), and at the laying of the second temple's foundation (Ezra 3:11). They are rendered here as in the Psalms.

decisions.choice: loyal love: faithful, covenant love
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith within a bond, here Yahweh's love for his people, as in Psalm 136:1.

decisions.choice: the house was filled with a cloud: told also in 1 Kings 8:10
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 8:10 says "the cloud filled the house of Yahweh", the known cloud of Yahweh's presence (Exodus 40:34). Chronicles says "the house was filled with a cloud, the house of Yahweh", repeating "house" for weight, and lets the cloud come as the praise is sung.

decisions.choice: instruments of song: the instruments used to accompany the singing
decisions.reason: "Instruments of song" is the usual name in Chronicles for the instruments of temple music (1 Chronicles 15:16; 16:42).

decisions.choice: for he is good, for his loyal love is forever (Literal); for he is good; his loyal love lasts forever (Balanced); He is good! His faithful love lasts forever (Readable)
decisions.reason: The refrain is worded as in 1 Chronicles 16:34 and the Psalms it quotes: "loyal love" at Literal and Balanced, "faithful love" at Readable. Every use of the refrain in 2 Chronicles (7:3, 6; 20:21) keeps this wording.

decisions.choice: the house, the house of the LORD (Balanced); the temple of the LORD (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the Hebrew's repeated "house". Readable says it once, as "the temple", as in 1 Kings 8:10, and begins a new sentence with "Then" since it broke the long sentence of verses 11-13 into shorter ones.

decisions.choice: "Porque [él es] bueno, porque su amor leal [es] para siempre" (L); "su amor fiel dura para siempre" (B); "¡Su amor fiel dura para siempre!" (R)
decisions.reason: The refrain of Psalm 136:1 (meaning decision); each level reuses the published Spanish of Psalm 136:1, as 1 Chronicles 16:34 and 2 Chronicles 20:21 do ("amor leal" at L, "amor fiel" at B and R).

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun on "él", "su" (L, B); none on sentence-initial "Él", "Su" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal and Balanced carry the span; Readable has none, and sentence-initial pronouns are written plain in the Spanish drafts.

decisions.choice: "car [il est] bon, car son amour loyal [est] pour toujours" (L); "car il est bon, car son amour fidèle dure toujours" (B); "Il est bon ! Son amour fidèle dure toujours." (R)
decisions.reason: The refrain is worded as the published French Psalms have it (Psalms 106:1; 136:1), so that it reads the same wherever it comes; the Psalms say "amour fidèle" at Balanced, where the English Balanced says "loyal love".

decisions.choice: kwa maana yeye ni mwema; upendo wake usiokoma unadumu milele
decisions.reason: The refrain is quoted in the wording of the Swahili Psalm 136:1 at each level, so "upendo usiokoma" stands at every level here, as the Psalm has it, though the English says "faithful love" at Readable.

decisions.choice: the refrain as the published Psalm 136:1
decisions.reason: The refrain "for he is good, for his loyal love is forever" (m2) keeps the Vietnamese of Psalm 136:1 at each level: "tình yêu thương thành tín" (L, B), "tình thương không hề thay đổi" (R).

decisions.choice: The refrain in the wording of the published Psalms (Psalm 136:1; 106:1): "한결같은 사랑" (L, B), "변함없는 사랑" (R)
decisions.reason: The refrain quotes Israel's song of praise (m2); Korean uses the Psalms' wording, which Samuel and Kings narrative now also use.

decisions.choice: Porque [ele é] bom, porque o seu amor leal [é] para sempre (L); Porque ele é bom; o seu amor leal dura para sempre (B); Porque ele é bom! O seu amor leal dura para sempre (R); render graças (L, B), agradecer (R)
alternatives: o seu amor fiel dura para sempre
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the refrain (m2) keeps the wording 1 Chronicles 16:34 has in Portuguese, one wording per level, "amor leal" at every level for God's chesed (m3); 7:3, 7:6 and 20:21 repeat it. "Render graças" (L, B) and "agradecer" (R) as 1 Chronicles 16:41. "Instrumentos de canto" (L) and "instrumentos musicais" (B) as 1 Chronicles 15:16.

decisions.choice: a casa se encheu de uma nuvem (L); a nuvem encheu a casa (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable keep the words of 1 Kings 8:10 in Portuguese, "a nuvem encheu a casa" (Readable "o templo"), the cloud of God's presence (m4). Literal keeps Chronicles' own form, a passive with "a cloud", as the English Literal does, and Balanced keeps the repeated "a casa".

decisions.choice: The refrain as Ezra 3:11 without "toward Israel": Literal «መልካም ነውና፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ነውና», Balanced and Readable «እርሱ መልካም ነው፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል»
decisions.reason: The same words of praise recur through Chronicles, Ezra and the Psalms and keep one wording; within the Balanced sentence the quotation has no full stop of its own.

decisions.choice: "क्योंकि [वे] भले [हैं], क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है]" (L); "क्योंकि वे भले हैं; उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है" (B); "वे भले हैं! उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है" (R)
decisions.reason: The refrain of Israel's praise is drafted here for Chronicles and the Psalms to reuse; the LORD's hesed is अटल प्रेम at every level, as the terms note sets, and God takes the honorific plural (वे, उनका).

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Hindi has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun spans in this chapter have no Hindi counterpart; the honorific plural वे, उनका marks God.

decisions.choice: "Потому что [он] благ, потому что вовек неизменная любовь его" (L); "Ведь он добр; его неизменная любовь длится вечно" (B); "Потому что он добр! Его неизменная любовь длится вечно." (R)
decisions.reason: The refrain of Israel's praise in the wording of 1 Chronicles 16:34 and 16:41 at each level, kept through 2 Chronicles (5:13; 7:3; 7:6; 20:21). The LORD's hesed is "неизменная любовь" at every level, Readable included, so the refrain reads the same each time. "Ибо", a Slavonicism the style guide avoids, and the familiar Synodal wording are not used.

decisions.choice: The refrain as 1 Chronicles 16:34, 16:41: "その方は良い方であり、その誠実はとこしえに[続く]" (L), "その方は良い方、その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続く" (B), "その方は良い方だから！その変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く" (R).
decisions.reason: The refrain keeps one Japanese form through Chronicles; chesed of God 誠実 (L), 変わらぬいつくしみ (B, R).

decisions.choice: L closes the long sentence here ("…とき、…満たされた。"), so verse 14 begins a new sentence.
decisions.reason: A Japanese main clause cannot wait until verse 14 and still keep verse 13's content in its own verse.

records.literal_gloss: and not were able the priests to stand to minister because of the cloud, for filled [the] glory of Yahweh [the] house of the God.

en.L: and the priests were not able to stand to minister because of the cloud, for the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} filled the house of God.
en.B: and the priests were unable to stand and do their service because of the cloud, since the house of God was full of the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The priests could not stand there to do their work because of the cloud. The glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} filled God's temple.

es.L: y no podían los sacerdotes estar de pie para servir a causa de la nube, porque la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} había llenado la casa de Dios.
es.B: y los sacerdotes no podían quedarse para hacer su servicio a causa de la nube, porque la casa de Dios estaba llena de la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Los sacerdotes no podían quedarse allí para hacer su trabajo a causa de la nube. La gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} llenó el templo de Dios.

fr.L: et les prêtres ne purent pas se tenir là pour faire le service, à cause de la nuée, car la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} remplissait la maison de Dieu.
fr.B: et les prêtres ne purent pas rester pour faire leur service, à cause de la nuée, car la maison de Dieu était remplie de la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Les prêtres ne pouvaient pas rester là pour faire leur travail, à cause de la nuée. La gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} remplissait le temple de Dieu.

sw.L: na makuhani hawakuweza kusimama ili kuhudumu kwa sababu ya wingu, kwa maana utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} uliijaza nyumba ya Mungu.
sw.B: na makuhani hawakuweza kusimama kufanya huduma yao kwa sababu ya wingu, kwa kuwa nyumba ya Mungu ilijaa utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Makuhani hawakuweza kusimama pale kufanya kazi yao kwa sababu ya wingu. Utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ulilijaza hekalu la Mungu.

vi.L: và các thầy tế lễ không thể đứng để phục vụ vì đám mây, vì vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đầy dẫy nhà của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: và các thầy tế lễ không thể đứng phục vụ được vì đám mây, bởi nhà của Đức Chúa Trời đầy dẫy vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Các thầy tế lễ không thể đứng đó làm việc vì đám mây. Vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tràn ngập đền thờ của Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장들은 구름 때문에 서서 섬길 수 없었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영광이 하나님의 집을 가득 채웠기 때문이다.
ko.B: 제사장들은 구름 때문에 서서 섬기는 일을 할 수 없었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영광이 하나님의 집에 가득 찼기 때문이다.
ko.R: 제사장들은 구름 때문에 그곳에 서서 일을 할 수 없었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영광이 하나님의 성전을 가득 채웠다.

pt.L: e os sacerdotes não puderam ficar de pé para ministrar por causa da nuvem, porque a glória {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} encheu a casa de Deus.
pt.B: e os sacerdotes não conseguiam ficar ali para fazer o seu serviço, por causa da nuvem, pois a casa de Deus estava cheia da glória {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Os sacerdotes não conseguiam ficar ali para fazer o seu trabalho, por causa da nuvem. A glória {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} enchia o templo de Deus.

am.L: ካህናቱም ከደመናው የተነሣ ለማገልገል ሊቆሙ አልቻሉም፤ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ክብር የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሞልቶት ነበርና።
am.B: የእግዚአብሔር ቤተ መቅደስ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ክብር ተሞልቶ ስለ ነበር ካህናቱ ከደመናው የተነሣ ቆመው ማገልገል አልቻሉም።
am.R: ካህናቱ ከደመናው የተነሣ በዚያ ቆመው ሥራቸውን መሥራት አልቻሉም። {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ክብር የእግዚአብሔርን ቤተ መቅደስ ሞልቶት ነበር።

hi.L: और याजक बादल के कारण सेवा करने के लिए खड़े न रह सके, क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की महिमा ने परमेश्वर के भवन को भर दिया था।
hi.B: और बादल के कारण याजक खड़े होकर अपनी सेवा न कर सके, क्योंकि परमेश्वर का भवन {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की महिमा से भरा हुआ था।
hi.R: बादल के कारण याजक वहाँ खड़े होकर अपना काम न कर सके। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की महिमा ने परमेश्वर के भवन को भर दिया था।

ru.L: и не могли священники стоять, чтобы служить, из-за облака, потому что слава {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} наполнила дом Божий.
ru.B: и священники не могли стоять и совершать служение из-за облака, потому что дом Божий был полон славы {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Из-за облака священники не могли оставаться там и делать свою работу. Слава {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} наполнила Божий храм.

ja.L: そして祭司たちは雲のために、立って仕えることができなかった。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の栄光が神の家を満たしたからである。
ja.B: 祭司たちは雲のために、立って務めを果たすことができなかった。神の家が{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の栄光で満ちていたからである。
ja.R: 雲のために、祭司たちはそこに立って仕事を続けることができませんでした。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の栄光が、神の神殿に満ちていたのです。

uk.L: і священники не могли стояти, щоб служити, через хмару, бо слава {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЯ|Ягве}} наповнила Божий дім.
uk.B: і священники не могли стояти й виконувати своє служіння через хмару, бо Божий дім був повний слави {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОЇ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Священники не могли стояти там і виконувати свою роботу через хмару. Слава {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЯ|Ягве}} наповнила Божий храм.

decisions.choice: told also in 1 Kings 8:11, as at the tabernacle
decisions.reason: The sentence is the same as 1 Kings 8:11, except that Kings ends "the house of Yahweh" and Chronicles "the house of God". Exodus 40:35 says that Moses was not able to enter the tent of meeting, because the cloud had settled on it and the glory of Yahweh filled the tabernacle. 7:1-2 tells of the glory filling the house again after Solomon's prayer.

decisions.choice: the glory of Yahweh: his presence made visible
decisions.reason: The glory is Yahweh himself present among his people. By filling the house he shows that he accepts it as his dwelling, as Solomon's words in the next chapter say (6:1-2).

decisions.choice: to stand to minister: to stay at their posts and serve
decisions.reason: Priests "stand before Yahweh to minister" (Deuteronomy 10:8; 18:5). The cloud made it impossible to remain in their place.

decisions.choice: lowercase "and"; the house was full of the glory (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced continue the sentence of verse 13. Balanced follows the wording of 1 Kings 8:11 and Exodus 40:35.

decisions.choice: as 1 Kings 8:11, with "a casa de Deus"
decisions.reason: The sentence is 1 Kings 8:11 (m1), and the Portuguese of 1 Kings is kept at every level, "a glória do SENHOR" included, with "a casa de Deus" (L, B) and "o templo de Deus" (R) where Kings names the LORD's house.

decisions.choice: The Amharic of 1 Kings 8:11 with "the house of God" ("የእግዚአብሔር ቤት") for the second "house of the LORD"
decisions.reason: Chronicles ends with "the house of God"; the name is not in the Hebrew there, so there is no divine_name span.
